analysis.reasonEn: Maintained a wait-and-see approach for the past 3 consecutive sessions. RSI has exited oversold territory and is consolidating in the neutral zone. MACD histogram shows improvement but remains negative. ADX indicates a strong trend at 31.3, but -DI is above +DI, suggesting downward pressure. Volume ratio of 0.54 indicates subdued activity, implying a lack of directional conviction. Current price of 95,085 KRW is near the swing resistance of 95,720 KRW. Maintaining a cautious stance until a clear direction emerges.
